# Sidhi Gym

> Free daily gym and morning run tracker. Log body weight, gym workouts, abs, field laps and progress. Built by Harry (SIDHIMUSIC).

Live: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/

## What it is
- Login / create account (name, username, password, male or female)
- Home: greeting, current weight, streak, week report, gym vs run duration
- Workout days D1–D7: Chest/Back/Shoulders + Abs A/B/C, animated exercise pics
- Separate Run tab: GPS walk/run and field lap mode
- Progress calendar and weight graph
- History of sessions
- PWA: can be added to home screen

## Not for
This is a personal training log. It is not medical advice.
